title: Atlanta healthcare jobs: physician, therapists, LPN, and behavior technician openings
text:
21 hours ago Atlanta job seekers are seeing five healthcare openings that span very different kinds of care. UnitedHealth Group’s American Health Network is recruiting a primary care physician, while Health Connect America and Thriveworks are both looking for licensed mental health clinicians, with the former role specified as part time and the latter full time. Kaiser Permanente’s opening is for a licensed practical nurse II, a hands-on nursing role, and Heartlinks ABA GA is hiring a registered behavior technician for part-time after-school work supporting ABA services for children. Together, the listings range from physician practice to behavioral health, nursing, and applied behavior analysis.
